business_profile: Advertising-led digital platform with rapidly growing Cloud and capital-intensive AI infrastructure
investment_lens: Quality-growth business assessed with GARP valuation discipline
reason: Estimate selected for distinct Services and Cloud economics, large AI reinvestment and central research costs. A style label does not set value. Forecasts remain provisional because future capital intensity, monetization and dilution are uncertain.

evidence.finding: Services and Cloud have separately reported revenue and operating results; shared AI costs sit outside segments.

distinction: Business profile determines model suitability. Investment lens does not set growth or margins. Valuation is conditional on the explicit operating forecast; the policy result is a separate investment screen. GARP is a price discipline, not an intrinsic company category.
